items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: So, I made the other side with him

ctx.x: The same Willie Jones, that I introduced you to. And, Jackie McLean, Mark Rose, J.R. Monterosa, Mal Waldron, Mel Larkin, and I had met Mingus before so it was just beautiful, because I went to Thelonious' house and he said, "Well, Wilbur, you're in New York now. You thought you was paying some dues in Chicago, but you're gonna pay some dues now in New York." Which I did. But this is my first year time in New York City, and like I said, I settled in Brooklyn, and I went out to a jam session, and

the first two cats I run in to -- jamming with -- was Matthew Bee Gene and Ernie Henry, and Matthew just made a record date for Riverside Records, which was a small company; they had a little storefront office on 49th -- between 9th and 10th or something like that. And, he had only did one side, so he said, 'I want you to make the other side.'

So, I made the other side with him, and that was Grauer and Orrin Keepnews my introduction to Bill, (inaudible). And I met some people from the Music Minus One, another storefront operation, and I made a recording -- Music Minus One. See, but when you made those recordings -- you might make it today, but it might take you anywhere from 2 to 4 weeks to get your money.
